column1: # Every table the engine reads, and what a row of it is.
# Engine-only. felix new copies templates by name and never this one: a
# project cannot declare its own schema, for the reason a project cannot
# declare an escape channel away. It is in FELIX_ESCAPE_TABLES by its full
# path, so a branch that removes a row here, or loosens one in place, stops at
# the merge boundary, and a file that happens to share the name in some
# product repository does not.
# One row per table, keyed by basename, checked by lib/table.sh:
#   table    the file's basename. Most end in .tsv; a table under another
#            name is declared the same way, and bin/schema-check then finds
#            it by that name
#   lives    tree: files in the checkout, which bin/schema-check enumerates on
#            every gate; memory: stores under the memory root, which no gate
#            can see, whose writers the suite checks against the row, and a
#            copy of which in the tree is refused
#   columns  the column names in order. A trailing ? marks a column a row may
#            leave off; only trailing columns may be optional, and a table has
#            either one column or at least two that every row carries
#   empty    refused: a table in the tree with no rows fails the gate, because
#            emptiness is never legitimate there; allowed: it is a real state
# The comment above each row says what an empty table and an absent one mean
# to the engine, by the function or command that decides it. It is a comment
# and not a column so that keeping it true costs nobody an escalation: the
# merge boundary compares rows, and every word of prose here would otherwise
# be a verdict somebody has to approve.
# A table the check finds with no row here fails it. A row whose table is not
# in the tree is reported and does not fail: some tables are absent until a
# project writes one, and a published copy of the engine leaves some behind.
# table
# Present and empty, every prompt is logged to routes.log as a miss and feeds
# felix route --promote (hooks/user-prompt). Absent, routing is off, nothing is
# logged, and felix route and felix ready die.
routes.tsv
# Present and empty, felix profile lists nothing and every capability reads as
# in no profile and never reached (felix_toolbox_route_for,
# felix_commission_gaps). Absent, felix profile dies and the rest reads as empty.
profiles.tsv
# felix new seeds it with comments only when the catalogue offers nothing.
# Empty or absent, every play entry renders as undeclared (_felix_route_kind,
# felix_ready_report). Absent, felix stack plan and apply die.
stack.tsv
column3: kind name source risk capability grounding?

column1: # Present and empty, every changed path is yellow, green is unreachable and no
# project channel escapes (felix_classify_diff, felix_escapes). Absent is not no
# risk: the receipt's tier is unknown and felix classify dies.
risk.tsv
column3: tier kind pattern reason channel? confine?

deny.tsv

ecosystem.tsv
# Nothing is demanded: felix evidence says no rule is declared and no merge

evidence.tsv

probes.tsv
# Present and empty, felix qualify returns 1 and the gate fails qualified.
# Absent, the gate skips and announces it.
qualification.tsv

obligations.tsv

exceptions.tsv

commissioning.tsv

column1: # Engine-only (templates/commission). Empty or absent, felix commission omits
# the steps no row answers (felix_commission_steps_unanswered), which reads
# exactly like every step answered: the silence the table exists to prevent.
steps.tsv
# Present and empty, felix maintenance says nothing is due, which reads like a
# kept-up project, and the session badge and the pulse say nothing
# (felix_maint_status). Absent, felix maintenance dies.
maintenance.tsv
# When each upkeep last ran, appended by felix maintenance --ran and tracked so
# the record travels with the project (felix_maint_record). Empty or absent,
# nothing has run yet, and every routine is due.
maintenance.log
# felix new writes it with comments only when no template row applies: nothing
# outstanding, and the human_steps need is met. Absent is different: felix
# setup dies and human_steps is not met.
setup.tsv
# What detection found in the checkout, one capability a line, written by
# felix new and felix adopt (felix_detect). Empty or absent, the project
# declares no capability, and every capability-keyed row stays dormant.
capabilities
# What Felix may do here unattended, one permission a line. Absent or empty,
# nothing is permitted, the state every project starts in (felix_autonomy_allows).
autonomy
# A person's stances on what each moment must answer. Absent or empty, every
# item is a gap (felix_procedures_gaps). No project has written one yet.
procedures.tsv
# Engine-only. Empty or absent, every procedure stance is unreachable and
# reported as a gap (felix_procedures_moments).
moments.tsv
# Engine-only, the stance behind the lifecycle_wired obligation. With comments
# only, every bound event is undeclared and lifecycle-check exits 1; zero bytes
# or absent, it exits 2 and the obligation reads unknown (felix_coverage_check).
lifecycle.tsv
# Engine-only. Empty or absent, felix new seeds a stack.tsv with comments only
# and felix recommend says every row is already declared, which cannot be told
# from a project that needs nothing.
catalog.tsv
column3: kind name source risk capability keywords?

column1: # Engine-only. Empty, only name fallback rules exist and felix doctor lists
# every capability as unruled. Absent is quieter: felix doctor says nothing, as
# if every capability had a rule (felix_capabilities_unruled).
discover-rules.tsv
# The public snapshot's acknowledgements. Empty or absent, nothing is waived and
# every audit hit stops the snapshot; only origin/main's copy waives anything.
# The snapshot itself does not carry it.
.snapshot-ack.tsv
# The red run always writes a base row and a run row (tests/red), and a record
# with neither fails the suite. Absent, the suite's record checks skip.
red.tsv
# Empty, the suite compares its run against nothing and says every assertion
# was reached, a pass that checked nothing. Absent, it says no manifest is
# recorded yet.
assertions.tsv
# Empty, no table has a row and bin/schema-check fails every table as
# undeclared. Absent, it cannot examine, which is never read as clean.
schemas.tsv
# No production reader. Absent, nothing governed has started, handed off or
# been summarised against this memory root since the recorder deployed, or
# every append failed: the writer never fails its caller, so the two cannot be
# told apart (lib/lifecycle.sh).
lifecycle.log
column3: time kind session bound installed head handoff transcript note

column1: # One row per declined route mandate, from felix route --ack (felix_route_ack).

decisions.log
